body_markdown:
OLDSMAR, FL


(September 30, 2026)— MarineMax, the world’s largest recreational boat and yacht retailer, received seven awards at the Scout Boats 2026 Dealer Meeting, including the top honors of Top Dealer Worldwide and Top Salesperson Worldwide. The awards recognize outstanding sales performance and customer service across Scout’s global dealer network.


MarineMax Charleston took home Top Dealer Worldwide, and Dotson Guice of MarineMax Charleston was named Top Salesperson Worldwide.


MarineMax’s 2026 Scout Dealer Award Recipients


-


Top Dealer Worldwide: MarineMax Charleston


-


Top Salesperson Worldwide: Dotson Guice, MarineMax Charleston


-


Top Mid Atlantic/Northeast Dealer: MarineMax Kent Island


-


Top Mid Atlantic/Northeast Salesperson: Perry Avery, MarineMax Kent Island


-


Top South Atlantic Dealer: MarineMax Wrightsville Beach


-


Anchor Award for Exceptional Service: MarineMax Ocean Reef & MarineMax Wrightsville Beach


The Anchor Award for Exceptional Service honors dealerships that deliver outstanding after-sale support and customer care. Two MarineMax locations earned this distinction this year. Scout Boats presented the awards at its annual dealer meeting.


“We are honored and humbled to receive Top Scout Dealer worldwide for the second year in a row. This achievement reflects tremendous focus, hard work, and a commitment to both the Scout brand and our mutual customers. Our partnership with the entire team at Scout is stronger than ever, and I’m confident it will continue to grow in the years ahead. Scout continues to develop new and exciting products, and we will be right there to champion and stand behind it as their top-performing dealer,” said Karl Anderson, General Manager of MarineMax Charleston.


Scout Boats is one of the most respected builders in the marine industry, designing and manufacturing luxury Center Console, Sport Fish, Bay Boats, and Yacht Tenders from 17 feet to 53 feet. They are known for state-of-the-art innovations, design, and high quality for both fishing and family activities. Come see how these award-winning Scout Boats dealers can help get you into the Scout model of your dreams.
